page_title: HEI 0-2 PAU | Heidenheim v St. Pauli 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The substitution is prepared. Scott Banks (St. Pauli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morgan Guilavogui.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' 0 - 2 Goal! Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:2. He was ably assisted there by Oladapo Afolayan.
90+2' The Heidenheim players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The goal for Heidenheim is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
87' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) slots the ball inside the back of the net and alters the score!
85' The free kick from long range, taken by St. Pauli, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Substitution. Noah Weisshaupt leaves the pitch and is replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
80' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) replaces Johannes Eggestein.
80' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' Substitution. Budu Zivzivadze will be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).

76' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
74' A cross from a corner kick by Heidenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
71' It's time for a substitution. Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) comes on in place of James Sands.
71' The corner by Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
70' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
69' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Marvin Pieringer is replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
69' Substitution. Jan Schoppner makes his way off the pitch and Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) comes on as his replacement.
66' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
65' The Heidenheim players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
58' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) swings in a cross from the corner, but Nikola Vasilj reads it well and gathers the ball.
58' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Heidenheim get a corner.
53' A short pass finds Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
49' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) brings an opponent down and Bastian Dankert interrupts the game.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Sirlord Conteh comes off for Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) and Leo Scienza is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Bastian Dankert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' It looks like Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) saw red with that tackle. Bastian Dankert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
38' James Sands (St. Pauli) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
32' The linesman raises his flag. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is adjudged offside.
28' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kevin Muller to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
24' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) is going to take the penalty!
24' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to St. Pauli!
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim).
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.

16' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Kevin Muller. St. Pauli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! St. Pauli will take the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
